slug: 我都成超人了灵气才复苏
content_zh:
午后。
烈日高悬，蝉鸣不绝。
“这到底是什么东西？”
宿舍内。
陈洛独自坐在床铺下方，观察着自己的手腕，眉头微皱。
“大残大残！一枪死！”
“大残是吧，一枪是吧，还在骗还在骗！”
他的三个舍友都待在宿舍里。
两个正在开黑，不时激情喊麦。
还有一个，大夏天的躲在被窝里，只偶尔传出短视频跳舞的背景音乐。
尽管环境略显嘈杂，但经过三年的磨合，陈洛甚至能做到在这样的环境下睡着。
发呆？那更是小菜一碟。
嗡嗡——
桌面上，手机屏幕亮起，将陈洛注意力拉回眼前。
【14级电子商务2班】
【班长——王成钢：@全体成员，校运会一周后举办，每个班至少得有六个人参加，现在还差四个名额，有没有同学愿意报名的？】
校运会这种活动，向来没什么实质性奖励。
撑死就是拿到名次后，对评优考核有一点点的额外加成。
但根据陈洛过往两年旁观的经验，名次大都是被各个院校的体育特长生包揽。
普通学生参加，那就是纯受罪。

扫过一眼，见不是什么重要事项，他便准备将手机放回去。
突然。
他看到熟悉的头像以及名称，出现在群聊中。
【陈洛：@班长——王成钢，班长你好，我愿意为班争光，报名一千五百米长跑和一百米短跑】
【班长——王成钢：好样的，记下了！】
【李阳：陈洛同学心系班级荣誉，好样的，向你致敬！（鼓掌）】
【杨浩强：陈洛同学心系班级荣誉，好样的，向你致敬！（鼓掌）】
....
先前还是一潭死水的群聊，被接二连三的刷屏占据。
妈的，一帮贱人。
陈洛暗暗咬牙，抓紧艾特班长，试图撤销报名。
他的消息转瞬被淹没。
班长王成钢更像死了一样，再没有任何动静。
显然，对方好不容易抓到壮丁，自然不肯放自己走。
啪！
见无力回天，陈洛重重按住手机，怒视隔壁床铺，原本还在刷视频的舍友。
被褥不时颤动，不是在打飞机，就是在偷笑。
“......”
陈洛凝视着被褥，缓缓起身。
他踩着桌子，扒住栏杆，顺势将身体拉起。

唰——
一把掀开被子。
content_en:
Afternoon.
The scorching sun is high and the cicadas are chirping incessantly.
"What the hell is this?"
Inside the dormitory.
Chen Luo sat alone under the bed, observing his wrist, frowning slightly.
"He's so disabled! He's shot to death!"
"Big disability, right? One shot, right? Still lying, still lying!"
His three roommates are all staying in the dormitory.
The two were playing black, shouting enthusiastically from time to time.
There is another one who is hiding under the covers in the summer, with only the occasional short video dancing background music playing.
Although the environment is slightly noisy, after three years of practice, Chen Luo can even fall asleep in such an environment.
daze? That's a piece of cake.
Buzz——
On the desktop, the mobile phone screen lit up, drawing Chen Luo's attention back to his eyes.
[Level 14 E-Commerce Class 2]
[Class leader——Wang Chenggang: @All members, the school sports meeting will be held in a week. At least six people from each class must participate. There are still four places left. Are there any students willing to sign up? 】
There are never any substantial rewards in activities like school sports meets.
The most important thing is that after getting the ranking, there will be a little extra bonus on the merit assessment.
But according to Chen Luo's experience in the past two years, most of the rankings were taken by students with sports talents from various colleges.
For ordinary students to participate, it would be pure suffering.
After glancing at it and seeing that it wasn't anything important, he was about to put the phone back.
Sudden.
He saw familiar avatars and names appearing in the group chat.
[Chen Luo: @ monitor——Wang Chenggang, hello, monitor, I am willing to bring glory to the class and sign up for the 1,500-meter long-distance race and the 100-meter sprint]
[Squad leader——Wang Chenggang: Well done, noted it down! 】
[Li Yang: Student Chen Luo cares about the honor of the class. Well done. I salute you! (Applause)]
[Yang Haoqiang: Student Chen Luo cares about the honor of the class. Well done. I salute you! (Applause)]
....
The group chat, which was previously a stagnant pool of water, has been occupied by a series of screen refreshes.
Damn, what a bunch of bitches.
Chen Luo gritted his teeth secretly, grabbed hold of Squad Leader Aite, and tried to cancel the registration.
His message was instantly drowned out.
Squad leader Wang Chenggang was more like dead, and there was no movement.
Obviously, the other party finally caught the young man and naturally refused to let him go.
Snap!
Seeing that he was helpless, Chen Luo pressed his phone heavily and glared at his roommate in the bed next door who was still scrolling through videos.
The quilt trembled from time to time, either masturbating or snickering.
"..."
Chen Luo stared at the quilt and slowly stood up.
He stepped on the table, grabbed the railing, and pulled his body up.
Swish——
Lifting the quilt.
